title: Bill To reads the payer's name when someone else pays
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, billed to customer B.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.
  • The customer shown at the top of the card is still customer A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S3-R2: “The field reads "This customer" when the customer pays for itself, otherwise the Bill To's name.”
  • Feature Overview, Core Bill To: “Every work order, part sale and invoice has two customers: the customer (the work is for them) and the Bill To (they owe the invoice). The Bill To starts as the customer itself.”
  • Terminology: “Customer → the customer the work is for: owns the truck, history, pricing and revenue. Called the "service customer" where both roles are named.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: pictures "Picked" (page 2 "Bill a work order or part sale to someone else", This build), "S2-17579" (page 2 "Bill a work order or part sale to someone else", This build), "Banner" (page 3 "When the Bill To is blocked", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p2-06-after-picked.png
  • bt-p2-08-after-s2-17579.png
  • bt-p3-14-after-banner.png

The design's own words:

  • “Picking "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair" saves at once. The card shows "Bill To" "Valders Diesel & Fleet Re", cut at the card's width.”
  • “"Bill To" reads "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair". Nothing is added to the card's header or the work order header.”
  • “Banner: "Cannot invoice. The Bill To customer, Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair, is on Credit Hold", with "Change Bill To".”

Difference BT-D06 on S3-R2 (BT-D06 name cut on desktop): this case follows the PRD; the design's version is asked in question 9.
